[center]This is a portrait mod[i](?)[/i] I made for Seasonal Younger Wizard using Talkohlooney's Artstyle! It replaces [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11523]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Cute Characters - SVE[/url] Wizard's [i](Magnus)[/i] portraits to a younger version of him based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10555?tab=description]Seasonal Younger Wizard - Moth's Vanilla Facelift-style Portraits[/url]. [b]Do please read the note I left in the folder for the portraits to work because I don't understand how to code lol.[/b][/center]

[b][size=4]ADDITIONAL NOTES:
[/size][/b]* Keep a copy of the Wizard's [i](Magnus)[/i] portrait folder incase you want to have his old version back.

* If you have already deleted it or completely replaced the Wizard's portrait without saving a copy & you want to get the ol ﻿﻿version of him back, then delete [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11523]1oxnes & Talkohlooney's portrait mod[/url] & reinstall it.

* If you have plans to make a proper mod out of my portraits, then [b]please ask for my permission[/b]. I can also provide a version ﻿﻿of the Wizard without the hat & may help make other versions of him [i](like the Flower Dance one)[/i] as long as it doesn't stray too ﻿﻿much from the portrait's I made.

* [b]YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED TO [u]HEAVILY[/u] EDIT MY WORK[/b]. Even if you ask for my permission, I will not allow it.
